Registration of Utah Marriage in UK
Hi I wonder if anyone has been through the same. I have an A5 visa and we need to show proof of registration of our Utah marriage in my home country (UK).

However, in the UK they accept the Utah Marriage as valid and therefore there is no need to register anywhere in fact they told me I cannot. I’m unclear on what paper I would need to bring in that case to Misrad Hapnim. 

Does anyone have a workaround? Thanks 🙏🏽 🌸
